'''2001 Massachusetts State Championship Hayes Hunter Hayes' MKOS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Hayes Hunter]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2001 Massachusetts State Championship]]. Hayes Hunter says this is card for card the Dark deck he won the 2001 Massachusetts State Championship with; Mike Gemme's post (DeckTech 15588) says he lost there to Hayes Hunter's deck played by Steebo Baroni.<ref name="dt-15366">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15366 Hayes' MKOS], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 17 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15366/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15366/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
